text.content:
Latin name: Via Peccati

Virtues: Conviction, Instinct

Followers of Via Peccati (Sinners) are angered that God has cursed them; denouncing God, they break all rules and indulge every desire that strikes their fancy. In pursuing the infinite vices of pleasure, and by gratifying every base desire, they strengthen their will into an ego so strong it will not bow before anything, including the Beast — while also sating the Beast's hunger, keeping it content. Sinners are not always agents of Satan; selfishness, not infernalism, is the core of this road, though those who dabble in infernalism do so for power and the Devil's favor. Sinners' interests range from sensual pleasure and seduction to corrupting others and exploring the limits of pain and degradation; Cainites of every clan are drawn to this road.

The Ethics:

  • You are already damned, so nothing is forbidden to you.
  • Claim the Beast and make it yours. Do not let it claim you.
  • The night is yours. Take what you want and do what you will.
  • Act where others hesitate. The laws of neither man nor God bind you.
  • In the dark depths of your heart lies pleasure, if you have the courage to free it.

Aura of Conviction (Corruption): Corruption. Sinners project an unsettling allure that plays on others' hidden desires and vices, gaining an aura modifier when tempting or corrupting a target.

Hierarchy of Sins (most to least severe):

  1. Acknowledging any moral restraint; failing to indulge a new desire.
  2. Failing to ride the wave of a frenzy; refusing to tempt the virtuous.
  3. Avoiding injury to others at the cost of your own pleasure.
  4. Turning down a chance for material gain.

vtmlarp.source: Faith and Fire (Dark Ages Vampire, revised as The Long Night)
